verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own Automation API documentation says the engine can 'create, update, configure, and destroy infrastructure dynamically', so a first-party destroy capability exists. Beyond that single thin mention, the pack does not document a full-environment teardown. The integration-test note about ephemeral infrastructure only implies teardown, and the community comment covers update-time deletion rather than a destroy operation. Missing for 10: documentation of a dedicated destroy command for a whole stack, evidence of clean, ordered teardown of all resources, handling of protected or retained resources, and independent hands-on corroboration.
